A little something, just for you

♡

For Sheetu,
with all my heart.

There are a few things I want to say, and I made this little place for them.

Take your time. There's no rush.

Chapter One / Honesty

♧

What I
understand now.

I've looked back with a softer, more honest heart. This is what I wish I had understood sooner.

For the past few months, I know I haven't treated our relationship the way it deserved to be treated. I didn't communicate properly, I blamed you for things, and whenever things became difficult, I repeatedly said that I wanted to end this relationship and even called it useless.

You always tried to make me understand that a relationship isn't something you throw away whenever things go wrong. A relationship is about understanding each other, having trust in one another, communicating through difficult times, accepting mistakes and choosing to work things out together.

I was so caught up in my anger and frustration that I failed to understand your feelings. I kept talking about ending our relationship instead of trying to understand and fix what was going wrong.

I cannot change the way I behaved in the past, but I genuinely want to change the way I treat you from now on.

With all my heart, I'm truly sorry, Sheetu. ❤️

with all my heart, ♡

Chapter Two / From my heart

♡

The things I
feel for you.

Some feelings are too deep for an ordinary message. Here is the part of my heart I want to share with you.

Sheetu,

There are so many things I feel for you that I probably haven't expressed properly. Somewhere between our arguments, misunderstandings and difficult days, I forgot to express the importance you hold in my life.

I value the little things about us — our silly conversations, our laughter, our special moments and even the ordinary days that become beautiful simply because we share them.

Sometimes my words have been completely opposite to what I actually feel, and I'm truly sorry for that.

But one thing I want you to understand is that despite all the difficult moments, my feelings for you haven't become meaningless. I don't want a relationship where everything has to be perfect. I want one where we can be ourselves, speak openly, understand each other, make mistakes, learn from them and grow together.

If I could change one thing about our past, it would be the way I handled the moments when you needed understanding instead of arguments.

You deserve to feel loved, respected and appreciated, not just through words on a screen, but through my actions too.

And Sheetu, I genuinely hope we can create many more beautiful memories together. ❤️

with all my heart, ♡

A little journey / Three doors

♡

Three things
I want you to know.

Choose any door. Each one holds a thought from my heart.

The little photo-hearts are just for you. ❄

Door One / Learning

♧

What I see differently now.

I understand that my words during arguments could make you feel that I was ready to give up on us. I should have listened instead of blaming, and tried to solve things instead of threatening to walk away.

I can't undo those moments, but I can take responsibility for them. I'm sorry for the hurt and uncertainty my words caused.

I am learning. ♡

Door Two / From my heart

♡

What you mean to me.

You matter to me, Sheetu. I value our conversations, our laughter and the memories we've made. I don't want difficult moments to erase the good things we've shared.

I want us to be able to speak honestly, listen to each other and make space for both of our feelings.

You are important to me. ♡

Door Three / Always

✧

The promise
I'm making.

I don't want to make grand promises I can't keep. I want to promise the small, real things that make love last.

Sheetu,

I promise to communicate with you instead of keeping things inside or letting misunderstandings grow.

I promise to listen to your feelings and try to understand your perspective rather than immediately blaming you or getting frustrated.

I promise that I won't bring up breaking our relationship every time we face difficult situations. I want to learn how to handle disagreements with patience, maturity and understanding.

I promise to give you the trust, respect, care and importance that a relationship deserves.

I know changing old habits takes time, and I don't expect everything to become perfect overnight. I'll genuinely work on myself and let my actions speak louder than my words.

Whenever things get difficult, I'll remember that we're two people trying to understand each other, not two people fighting against each other.

With all my heart, I want to do better. ❤️

with all my heart, ♡

The last page / A new beginning?

♡

Can we write
a new chapter?

I don't expect an answer just because you've read this. I only hope we can talk, understand each other and see whether we can rebuild something healthier together.

If you need time, I'll respect that. Your feelings and your choice matter.

♡

Thank you for reading, Sheetu.

Whatever you decide, I wanted you to know that I'm truly sorry.

with all my heart, ♡
